title: Attach the Firebase client to one app
description: The per-app half of the Firebase layer: tags the app platform:web and asks the app's stack adapter to wire the Firebase client (Angular: environment files, firebase.config.ts + per-service configs, emulator-overrides.ts, proxy.conf.mjs, the production/staging fileReplacements, provideAppFirebase(), firebase + @angular/fire). An app whose stack has no Firebase port is reported and left alone. The emulator suite itself is the firebase-emulators generator.

project.description: The app to attach the Firebase client to.

workspaceName.description: Workspace identity that seeds the offline `demo-<name>` project id in the app's environment file. Defaults to the project name.

staging.description: Also scaffold the staging environment file and the `staging` build configuration that selects it.

wireProviders.description: Wire the Firebase provider into the app's bootstrap. TRUE ONLY WHEN ENSURING the layer (creating the capability) — the bootstrap file is seeded, never owned, so a detect-only sync must not write to it.
